pages.title: African Savannah Elephant
pages.text: The African savannah elephant ($(o)Loxodonta africana$()), or African bush elephant, is a large elephant found across sub-Saharan Africa in savannahs, grasslands and woodlands.$(br2)It is the largest living land animal. Its enormous ears help release body heat, and both males and females carry tusks.$(br2)African savannah elephants live in family herds led by an older female, the matriarch. The species is listed as Endangered.
